text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The URA Finale is a stage upon which all

Umamusume can shine.

At long last, the day of the preliminaries
has
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you for seeing

<chrname> off.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You've finally made it this far. As a fan,
I'm
elated.

Heheheh, I've no doubt. I'm looking
forward to
the race!
choice_data_list: 最高のレースにしてみせます！
choice_data_list_en: I'll make this the greatest race ever!

text_block_list.text:
The gates will fly open any minute now...
URA
Finale, here we come!
